title: The Darkening
description: This modpack brings multiple mods to create a horrific and terrifying world.
body:
The Darkening brigs together multiple mods to create a horror environment to scare the player. this modpack also adds multiple new mobs and and items to put together the horrifing element. 

Some of the mods in this modspack include:

-Biomes O' Plenty

-Guns ++

-Just Enough Items

-Simple Voice Chat

-The Deep Void

-The End of Herobrine

-The God

-The man from the fog

-WTHIT

But the modpack does have over 90 Mods/shaders installed
